children: PIF  - LAUNCHES TAWRID TO PROVIDE SUPPLY-CHAIN FINANCING PRODUCTS IN SAUDI ARABIA
PIF - TAWRID OBTAINED THE SAUDI CENTRAL BANK’S “SAMA” PERMIT TO OPERATE UNDER THE REGULATORY “SANDBOX” ENVIRONMENT
PIF - TAWRID WILL PLAY A SIGNIFICANT ROLE IN CONNECTING BUYERS, SUPPLIERS, AND FUNDERS THROUGH ITS DIGITAL PLATFORM
PIF - TAWRID WILL OFFER PRODUCTS SUCH AS EARLY SETTLEMENT OPTIONS AGAINST APPROVED INVOICES
PIF - TAWRID STARTED OPERATIONS AND ALREADY SIGNED BINDING AGREEMENTS WITH LOCAL BANKS AND COMPANIES
